HotelIntro.quote: Di perairan di mana masa terhenti, cari tempat perlindungan yang hanya milik anda
HotelIntro.body1: Meili Resort terletak di Semporna, Sabah, Malaysia, bersebelahan dengan Pulau Sipadan yang terkenal di dunia. Rumah kepada salah satu ekosistem marin terkaya di Bumi, ia dikenali sebagai syurga penyelam.
HotelIntro.body2: Resort kami menggabungkan keselesaan moden dengan keindahan alam semula jadi. Setiap bilik menghadap lautan, membolehkan anda bangun dengan ombak lembut dan tidur di bawah bintang-bintang. Sama ada snorkeling, menyelam, atau menikmati masa pantai yang santai, kami memenuhi setiap visi percutian yang sempurna.

Villas.title: Kediaman Lautan Peribadi Anda
Villas.subtitle: Vila & Suite
Villas.desc: Setiap bilik direka dengan teliti, menggabungkan keindahan alam dengan keselesaan moden. Dari vila atas air hingga suite pemandangan laut, kami mencipta penginapan yang tidak dapat dilupakan.

items.title: Suite Vila Atas Air Pemandangan Pantai 1 Bilik Tidur
items.desc: Suite vila di tepi lagun, dengan teres luas yang menghadap pantai pasir putih resort.

items.title: Suite Vila Atas Air POERAVA 2 Bilik Tidur
items.desc: Kemewahan terkini di dua bilik tidur dengan kolam rendam peribadi yang membuka terus ke laut jernih Semporna.

items.title: Ladang Vila Tepi Pantai Premium 3 Bilik Tidur
items.desc: Ladang tepi pantai peribadi yang tiada tandingan, sesuai untuk percutian keluarga, berdekatan pasir putih dan pokok kelapa.

items.title: Ladang Vila Tepi Pantai Premium 2 Bilik Tidur
items.desc: Nikmati masa peribadi di halaman tepi pantai eksklusif anda, di mana ruang tamu luas menyatu dengan alam semula jadi.

items.title: Suite Atas Air Kolam Rendam Otemanu 1 Bilik Tidur
items.desc: Pemandangan gunung ikonik, kolam rendam peribadi, dan pengalaman hidup atas air yang romantis.

nav.description: Resort kami terletak di atas perairan biru Semporna, Sabah, Malaysia, bersebelahan dengan terumbu karang yang indah, mudah dikunjungi dengan kereta dan bot laju dari Lapangan Terbang Tawau.
nav.contactText: Biar kami uruskan pengangkutan dan jadual anda.

hero.title: 4°U — Koordinat Lautan Peribadi Anda
hero.subtitle: Semporna, Malaysia · Jantung Segitiga Terumbu Karang · Bersebelahan Sipadan

intro.desc1: Meili Resort terletak di atas perairan Semporna, Malaysia — pada 4–5°U, 118–119°T, berhampiran khatulistiwa. Suhu sepanjang tahun 26–32°C menjadikannya destinasi tropika yang ideal.
intro.desc2: Semporna dilindungi secara semula jadi oleh Pulau Mindanao dan Borneo, menempatkannya di zon buta laluan taufan. Dalam lebih 100 tahun, tiada taufan pernah melanda — menjadikannya "Tanah di Bawah Angin."
intro.desc3: Resort ini terletak bersebelahan Pulau Sipadan, tapak menyelam bertaraf dunia, di mana tebing bawah laut yang curam dan hidupan marin yang menakjubkan menarik penyelam dari seluruh dunia.

bajau.title: Penjaga Laut Selama Berabad-Abad
bajau.desc1: Orang Bajau, dikenali sebagai "Nomad Laut", telah hidup di perairan ini turun-temurun. Dilahirkan dan dibesarkan di atas lautan, mereka menyelam bebas senatural bernafas, hidup harmoni bersama terumbu karang sejak ribuan tahun lalu.
bajau.desc2: Mereka adalah penjaga paling setia lautan ini — dan kisah paling mengesankan di sini. Di Meili Resort, anda akan berpeluang mendengar kisah abadi antara manusia dan lautan ini.

route.title: Pemindahan Ketibaan Inklusif Penuh
route.airportHint: Kami syorkan terbang terus melalui Tawau (TWU)
route.divider: Semua di bawah diatur oleh Meili Resort
route.promise: Dari Lapangan Terbang Tawau, pasukan kami menemani anda di setiap langkah. Di setiap titik pemindahan, seseorang dari pasukan kami akan menunggu.

schedule.title: Jadual Pemindahan Eksklusif
schedule.notice1: Jadual di atas terpakai pada hari daftar masuk dan daftar keluar anda
schedule.notice2: Sila kongsi butiran penerbangan sekurang-kurangnya 3 hari sebelum ketibaan — kami akan ada menunggu
schedule.notice3: Jika penerbangan anda lewat atau berubah, hubungi kami bila-bila masa — kami akan selaraskan agar anda tidak menunggu di jeti

prepare.title: Kami Sudah Fikirkan Segalanya
prepare.subtitle: Senarai ini dibina daripada pengalaman bertahun-tahun menyambut tetamu seperti anda
items: Pengesahan tempahan (tangkapan skrin sudah cukup — kami sudah ada rekod anda)
Kasut tidak licin (untuk dek bot laju)
Cermin mata hitam dan topi matahari
prepare.tip: Segala-galanya di pulau sudah disediakan untuk anda. Bawa barang ringkas. Butler peribadi anda akan uruskan selebihnya.

cta.title: Perjalanan Anda Bermula Sebaik Anda Membuat Tempahan
cta.titleEn: Your Journey Begins the Moment You Book
cta.desc: Setelah tempahan disahkan, hantar butiran penerbangan kepada kami. Pasukan kami akan mengesahkan peraturan pemindahan sebelum anda berlepas — dan menunggu anda di jeti.

arrival.title: Setiap Batu Perjalanan, Dikurasi untuk Anda
arrival.subtitle: Dari bandar berlepas hingga ke Meili Resort — pemindahan eksklusif yang lancar menanti anda
arrival.stage1Body: Naiki penerbangan domestik dari Kuala Lumpur, Kota Kinabalu atau bandar lain. Lapangan Terbang Tawau hanya 1.5 jam.
arrival.stage2Body: Kenderaan hotel peribadi anda menunggu di ketibaan. Luncur melalui bandar tepi pantai Semporna sambil angin laut mula menenangkan jiwa.
arrival.stage3Body: Bot laju peribadi berlepas dari jeti. Tiga puluh minit di lautan terbuka, dan syurga pulau anda muncul di cakrawala.
arrival.footer: Perjalanan ketibaan anda diurus dari saat anda mendarat. Kongsi butiran penerbangan selepas tempahan, dan butler peribadi anda akan menguruskan selebihnya.

images.title: Crystal Waters at 4°N
images.desc: The crystal clear glass sea reflects the pure sky unique to the equator.

images.title: Every Morning Belongs to You
images.desc: Gently awakened by the waves, opening the window reveals an endless blue canvas.

images.title: Unrushed Sunsets
images.desc: Rose-colored glowing clouds slowly burn on the sea level, making time stand still.

images.title: A Century Without Typhoons
images.desc: In this sea blessed by gods, the brilliant starry sky quietly accompanies every night.

images.title: Coral Triangle, Semporna
images.desc: The world's richest marine habitat, where life blooms brilliantly.

images.title: Land Below the Wind
images.desc: Warm all year round, sheltered from monsoons, leaving only gentle sea breezes.

images.title: Nature's Unique Miracles
images.desc: Every day's tide and cloud movement is a unique painting tailored by nature.

images.title: 3,000 Species of Fish
images.desc: Colorful schools of fish dart through, forming a vibrant underwater palace.

images.title: Barracuda Tornado
images.desc: Thousands of barracudas spiral and migrate, forming a breathtaking underwater tornado.

images.title: Swim with Sea Turtles
images.desc: In the gentle ocean currents, roam alongside these ancient wise creatures of the sea.

images.title: Sipadan, Top Diving Spot
images.desc: Cliffs on the edge of the abyss harbor the lifelong yearning of diving enthusiasts.

images.title: Five-Star Diving Club
images.desc: Professional team escorts all the way, making every dive into the deep blue a safe adventure.

images.title: Half Ocean, Half Sun
images.desc: Sunlight penetrates the surface, refracting layered light and shadows, lighting up every coral.

images.title: 76% of Global Coral Species
images.desc: Here lies the densest treasure trove of coral species on Earth, bursting with colors.

images.title: Professional Guidance
images.desc: From beginners to veteran divers, everyone can find their own deep-sea paradise here.

images.title: Vibrant Night Dive
images.desc: Night dives unveil another layer of mystery, with nocturnal creatures bringing stunning contrasts.

images.title: Over 300 Water Villas
images.desc: Private floating homes above coral reefs, each offering an independent expanse of sea and sky.

images.title: Natural BELIAN Ironwood
images.desc: Ancient timber spanning centuries, bearing the rock-solid promise of enduring architecture.

images.title: A Quiet Night Stay
images.desc: Warm yellow lights illuminate the sea, ensuring peaceful solitude amidst utter tranquility.

images.title: Open to the Ocean
images.desc: No far travel needed; gently open the door to plunge directly into this cool blue embrace.

images.title: Sacred BELIAN Wood
images.desc: The sacred tree of the natives transforms into the solid cornerstone guarding this sea city.

images.title: Privacy & Comfort
images.desc: Open spatial design with high-spec furnishings offers ultimate luxury in a secluded hideaway.

images.title: Every Step on Water
images.desc: Stretching wooden boardwalks connect the resort, making every stroll feel like walking on waves.

images.title: Guinness World Record
images.desc: A miracle where human architectural history coexists harmoniously with natural environments.

images.title: 24h Butler Service
images.desc: Attentive private butlers ensure that every one of your needs is properly taken care of.

images.title: All-Inclusive Dining
images.desc: Leave worries behind and fully savor every abundant gift prepared for you by the resort.

images.title: 396,000 sqm Built on Water
images.desc: A massive engineering scale, growing a magnificent sea city on shallow shoals far from land.

images.title: Tons of Immortal Wood
images.desc: Precious century-old preserved timber builds the massive structure, resilient to crashing waves.

images.title: Wooden Bridge Above the Deep
images.desc: Look down to spy schools of fish darting between the pilings; architecture and ocean coexist.

images.title: A City Upon the Ocean
images.desc: The scattered villa clusters resemble a magnificent pearl necklace draped across the sea surface.

images.title: 100% Secure & Guarded
images.desc: Exclusive security forces patrol and station here, ensuring absolute peace of mind for every stay.

images.title: The Birth of a Legend
images.desc: Gathering exceptional craftsmanship to stand this awe-inspiring legacy deep in the ocean.

images.title: Infinity Pool
images.desc: The pool blends seamlessly with the sea, as if you are swimming far across the grand Pacific.

images.title: Ocean View Spa
images.desc: Accompianied by ocean waves, let body and mind stretch fully under the care of premium oils.

images.title: Ocean View Gym
images.desc: Sweat before an open ocean view, giving exercise a touch of expansive freedom.

images.title: Yoga Pavilion
images.desc: Facing the ocean sunrise, sit on the tranquil wooden deck to find inner balance.

images.title: Water Sports Center
images.desc: Paddleboarding, kayaking, island hopping—endless water activities to keep you thrilled.

images.title: Boutique Shopping
images.desc: Stroll through this miniature gallery and choose a souvenir infused with ocean vibes.

images.title: Banquet Hall
images.desc: Host meetings or parties between sea and sky, creating lifelong unique memories.

images.title: Mini Golf
images.desc: A mini putting green amidst sea breezes brings you the relaxed pleasure of a lightweight swing.

images.title: Michelin Quality Dining
images.desc: International chefs select local ingredients to present an artistic feast for the palate.

images.title: Sunset Bar
images.desc: Order a custom cocktail and watch the sunset dye the ocean surface an enchanting amber.

images.title: All Day Dining
images.desc: Gathering abundant flavors from around the world to soothe taste buds anytime after a dive.

images.title: Fresh Seafood
images.desc: Zero distance from deep sea to table; every bite is filled with the ocean's purest sweetness.

images.title: Every Meal on Water
images.desc: Dine to the gentle murmur of ocean waves, with an unobstructed view of sprawling deep blue.

images.title: Tipsy Nights
images.desc: Raise a glass in the quiet sea breeze, enjoying a different romantic touch after nightfall.

images.title: Moments For You
images.desc: Specially customized private tables, dedicated to capturing the most moving stories between you.
